title: LMS-NG shared enum definitions
description: One $defs entry per enum, referenced by JSON Pointer (#/$defs/<name>) from every other schema in this bundle. Values here are additive-safe: a MINOR contract bump may add a new enum value, but removing or renaming one is a MAJOR change (docs/decisions/G-A_DECISION_PACKET.md section on versioning).

origin.description: LIVE = read from a real Arduino board via the RS485 capture chain. SIMULATED = produced by the TEST-site simulator, never real hardware. IMPORT = a historical/recorded replay ingested through the authorized import path. Immutable once set on a record; a retry of a LIVE message stays LIVE even if delivered late (revised plan section A.6).

clockQuality.description: Whether the producing process's clock is known to be NTP-synced. UNCERTAIN means the offset itself is unknown, not just large. A consumer must not certify cross-machine latency when this is anything but SYNCED (revised plan section A.8, test U08).

direction.description: UP/DOWN only while the UP or DN contact is exclusively closed. Both closed at once, or neither while motion=RUNNING, is UNKNOWN plus a dataQuality.directionConflict flag -- never guessed at (test G12).

motion.description: Whether the car is physically moving right now, distinct from direction (which can be stale/last-known while motion is UNKNOWN). Directly backs the HUD's requirement to stop animating on motion=UNKNOWN (revised plan section D.3 rule 2).

operatingMode.description: UNKNOWN is required, not optional-with-a-default, because FIRE/FIRE_RETURN pins have never been physically activated on this building -- their absence must never be read as NORMAL (revised plan section A.7).

connectionState.description: Liveness/commissioning state as seen by the Platform for one elevator. AWAITING_FRESH_PROOF is the state right after a Gateway reconnect where a retained presence value says ONLINE but no fresh heartbeat/state has arrived yet -- retained truth is never trusted as current on its own (revised plan section A.4). PENDING_INSTALL/NOT_COMMISSIONED/OUT_OF_SERVICE are three DISTINCT reasons a lift shows no live data (revision R12) -- they must never collapse into one another (test U05: W-04's OUT_OF_SERVICE must not render as PENDING_INSTALL).

floorKind.description: LANDING = a code with a known building floor label. TRANSIT = a code the car passes through but never stops at (building codes 4, 9, 11 on the WHZ-PAX profile). UNCALIBRATED = a code whose real-world floor is not yet established (all of W-05's codes 3..46). UNCALIBRATED codes render as 'code N', never a guessed label (test U04).

dataQualityFlag.description: POSITION_BIT_SUSPECT replaces the old plan's SENSOR_VS2_FAULT naming (revised plan section B.5): it is a diagnostic candidate rule, not an assertion that a sensor is broken, until an operator/calibration step confirms it.

alarmState.description: ACTIVE/CLEARED is the physical condition; ACKED/CLOSED is the operator workflow layered on top. An ACK must never clear a condition that is still physically true (revised plan section F.2).

commandMode.description: REAL elevators only ever accept DRY_RUN in this POC -- the RS485 link is transmit-only by hardware (MAX485 DE/RE tied high). A server MUST refuse LIVE for any REAL-origin elevator regardless of caller role (test S05).

source.description: WebSocket/REST-facing source flag that drives the DEMO banner. Distinct from the wire-level 'origin' enum -- 'demo' here means a per-session overlay, never a value published over MQTT (see contracts/mqtt spec, origin never equals demo).
